messages:
maria: Quick triage summary — discovered a kubelet/incluster webhook combo issue (CVE-2026-0891) that lets a compromised node escalate via malformed CSR acceptance. Affects ingress controllers that call cert-manager webhook and older kubelet versions. Need patch wave + RBAC hardening + audit logging + KMS coordination.

raj: Which clusters are in-scope? prod, staging, or also edge clusters?

maria: In-scope: gke-prod (eu-west1), self-hosted-eu (on-prem), and two edge clusters in ap-east for legacy infra. Ingress-nginx 1.7.2 and kubelet 1.24.8 seen in inventory. cert-manager webhook 1.10.x on some nodes. Upstream fixes: ingress 1.7.3, kubelet 1.24.12, cert-manager 1.12.0.

dina: Proposal: 3-wave plan — (1) staging quick patch now, (2) 10% prod canary on low-traffic nodes for 45m, (3) full prod roll after smoke tests. RBAC: tighten node bootstrap role to remove excessive approve permissions.

oliver: Note on KMS/cert-manager: rotating the KMS-wrapped TLS key for the webhook will cause cert-manager webhook restarts and transient failures in admission. We should NOT rotate KMS keys during the patch waves. Defer KMS rotate to post-rollout. Also bump audit retention to catch any suspicious CSR approves.

maria: Audit policy snippet to add to control-plane (append):
```
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
rules:
- level: RequestResponse
  resources:
  - group: "cert-manager.io"
    resources: ["certificates", "certificaterequests"]
  - group: ""
    resources: ["secrets"]
```
This will help capture webhook and secret operations.

raj: Canary patch command for ingress (staging):
```
kubectl -n ingress set image deploy/nginx-ingress-controller nginx-ingress-controller=nginx/nginx:1.7.3 --record
```
I'll also create a rollout hook to rollback on >=2% 5m error rate.

nora: Smoke tests to run during canary: webhook-admission-test, cert renewal simulation, kubelet node-probe. I'll run them and post logs. Expect a small spike in p99 if we hit cold paths.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by raj: gke-staging/ingress at 1779993350 — automated health checks enabled.

dina: After canary success I'll run these checks: `kubectl auth can-i --list --namespace=kube-system` across nodes, and aggregate api-server audit denies with `jq` script. I'll drop an artifact link when ready.

maria: RBAC change (draft):
```
kind: ClusterRole
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: system:node-bootstrap-limited
rules:
- apiGroups: ["certificates.k8s.io"]
  resources: ["certificatesigningrequests"]
  verbs: ["create", "get"]
```
We will bind this to a restricted subject list only.

oliver: Also double-check etcd backups before any mass kubelet roll. If we see webhook errors, have a fallback to pin earlier ingress/cert-manager images in the router.

raj: Action items I have: prepare canary manifest, add automated rollback trigger, post rollout notes in #incidents.

dina: I'll collect audit logs and RBAC can-i outputs to a temporary S3 path and share.

maria: Summary of action list: 1) staging canary (raj) 2) run smoke (nora) 3) RBAC restrict (maria+dina) 4) KMS rotate postponed (oliver) 5) audit collection (dina). Ping @oncall if anything fails. :white_check_mark:

raj: Starting the canary now, will update on progress. Link to playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/k8s-patch-waves-2026

maria: Thanks — keep updates here. I'll open an incidents thread if we need a formal escalation.
